list.snippet: Online: Go to Air India Official Website, log into Manage Booking with your PNR and last name, select your flight segments, and cancel. Online cancellations automatically trigger refund processing.
Travel Agents: If you booked through a third-party site or travel agent, you must contact them directly to handle the cancellation and refund.
Validity: Refund requests are valid up to two years from the ticket issuance date.
Processing Time: Direct refunds typically take 7 to 10 business days (delays can extend up to 15–20 days) to reflect in your original payment source.

Cancellation Fees: Deductions depend on your fare class (Basic, Value, Classic, Flex) and timing. Canceling inside the no-show window (less than 2 hours for domestic, 4 hours for international) results in forfeiture of the base fare.

Full Refunds: Allowed if canceled within specific statutory/airline windows (such as within 24 hours of booking if outside the departure threshold) or if Air India cancels or significantly changes your flight.
Add-ons: Ancillary services like pre-paid meals, extra baggage, or seat selection are generally non-refundable.
